ruling.recommended_action: Route to a human reviewer: (1) code-of-conduct review of the driver's "Shut up and let me drive" (SAFE-1 abuse); (2) recompute the RD-2 refund on the unexempt segment once the safety review is cleared; (3) no account flag on route-repetition grounds (no upheld disputes in profile).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first. The driver's chat message at 09:05, "Shut up and let me drive" (F9), is hostile language aimed directly at the rider, and the complaint adds that the rider felt unsafe. Ryde's code of conduct bars abuse of any kind, so this is at least a suspected SAFE-1 case: I do not rule on the merits and escalate to a human. (The separate routing facts are set out for the reviewer.)

Route analysis: the trip ran 21.4 km against a 15.9 km optimal route (+5.5 km, F1) with a single off-route segment 09:00–09:11 covering 6.89 km where the optimal route covers 1.75 km, i.e. +5.14 km and up to 1481 m off the optimal line (F3). Under RD-1 that is an unexempted detour unless RD-3/RD-4/RD-5 saves it. No rider-named stop exists (no such message), and no rider message precedes the segment: the only two messages are the rider's question at 09:04 and the driver's reply at 09:05 (F8, F9, F10, all timestamped), i.e. consent after the segment and in fact objection rather than consent (RD-5; a driver's verbal-agreement claim would not count under G11). The driver's written statement that the GPS rerouted him (F11) is a post-trip assertion; RD-4 requires a traffic incident on the substituted optimal route, and none is recorded (F14). The congestion bands (F12 PIE band 5 = 40–49 km/h; F13 KPE band 4 = 30–39 km/h) are not band 1–2 and under RD-4(b) cannot exempt a segment on their own. The segment therefore counts (ground: no consent before the segment; finding: counts).

Amount if the reviewer proceeds: RydeTAXI bills by meter, so the detour distance is chargeable excess (RD-2). 5.14 km × $1.4102/km (the trip's distance fare ÷ distance, F4) = $7.25; billed excess distance was $7.83 (F4) but only the unexempt segment's extra_km is refundable, and the $0.11 waiting item (F5, 0.4 min at $0.26/min) is a metered wait charge not tied to the detour, so it is not refunded. Proposed refund: $7.25 as a Ryde voucher (NS-7). No flag_account: the driver has 1 dispute with 0 upheld in 90 days (F17), so RD-6's "repeated" condition is not met.

Evidence status is sufficient: GPS (F1–F3), fare (F4–F7), traffic (F12–F14) and a fully timestamped chat record (F10) settle every element; the escalate is driven by SAFE-1, not by an evidence gap.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety screen: driver's chat message "Shut up and let me drive" (F9) is hostile/abusive language aimed at the rider, and the rider reports feeling unsafe. SAFE-1 requires escalation to a human rather than an automated ruling. For the human reviewer, the route analysis is: the off-route segment F3 (09:00–09:11, +5.14 km) counts under RD-1/RD-2 — the driver's "the GPS rerouted me" claim (F11) is a post-trip statement with no traffic evidence (F14; the speed bands F12/F13 merely show 30–49 km/h flow, insufficient to excuse a 5.14 km detour under RD-4), the only chat messages (F8, F9) post-date the detour, and no rider consent existed before 09:00 (RD-5, G11/G12). Refund basis: 5.14 km × $1.4102/km (F4 unit rate) = $7.25; billed excess distance was $7.83 (F4) and the waiting charge of $0.11 (F5) is a legitimate metered item, so the amount to be refunded is $7.25 as a voucher (RD-2, NS-7). No account flag: driver profile shows 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days (F17).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:00–09:11 adds 5.14 km / up to 1481 m from the optimal route (F3, RD-1). No rider message before 09:00 agrees to any detour; the only chat messages (F8 rider question 09:04, F9 driver reply 09:05) come after the segment and the rider is objecting, so there is no RD-5 consent (G11/G12). The driver's written statement that the GPS rerouted him (F11) is a post-trip claim with no supporting traffic incident on the substituted route (F14); the congestion bands F12/F13 (band 4–5, 30–49 km/h) are corroborative at most and RD-4(b) cannot exempt the segment alone. The segment is therefore an unexempted detour under RD-2: 5.14 × $1.4102 = $7.25.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement ('the GPS rerouted me') is a post-trip account, not rider consent, and no traffic incident or blocked-route evidence supports a reasonable cause for the 5.14 km detour (F14; RD-4/RD-5, G11).
Waiting charge $0.11 (0.4 min × $0.26/min) is a metered RydeTAXI item not arising from the detour; not refundable under RD-2.
